summary: Skip the mutants in code that the compiler evaluates outside function bodies. The Go coverage profile has no block for this code, so no test run can cover it. internal/engine gives the status SKIPPED to a mutant in a package-level type declaration, and in the signature of a function, a method, or a function literal of a package-level variable. The signature span ends at the opening brace of the body. The mutants in the bodies keep their coverage. The quick start describes the behavior. No internal dependency, CLI flag, configuration key, JSON report field, or exit code changes.
trust_boundaries: The engine reads the Go files that it already reads for the mutant discovery. It adds no network access and runs no scanned source. The change keeps the development-check, delivery-finalization, and merge-queue-policy boundaries unchanged.
